_what: Rock job #2: drain the copier's built-in scan share into SharePoint, so nobody ever has to hear the Win+R network-drive speech again. The copier keeps hosting; the rock moves settled files to the cloud and deletes behind itself.
_shareNote: The e-STUDIO's built-in share is usually FILE_SHARE. Verify in TopAccess (Administration -> Setup -> Save as File) or with:  net view \\192.168.10.11
_smbNote: Copier SMB credentials are stored one time in Windows Credential Manager, as the task's account:  cmdkey /add:192.168.10.11 /user:admin /pass:<the copier password>
_targetNote: TODO before first run: pick the site scans should land in (recommend a general office site, NOT the prayer-list site - different audience, different permissions), grant the app write on it exactly like the prayer site grant (OPERATIONS.md section 5 step 4, new siteId), then fill these in. Get the siteId in Graph Explorer:  GET https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/sites/lithiaspringsmethodist.sharepoint.com:/sites/<siteName>
_settleNote: Files younger than this are still being written by the scanner; leave them for the next pass.
